responsibility: Implements the ARC target’s C-family preprocessor builtin hook. It defines the stable set of architecture-visible macros and assertions for the currently selected ARC configuration, including generic __arc__ identity, feature and CPU-condition macros driven by the declarative arc-c.def table, TLS register number and LP_COUNT width numeric macros, endianness markers, and hard-vs-soft-float predefines, by calling cpplib from TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS.
same_name_distinction: Implements the C-family frontend side of the ARC stem group: the TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS hook that emits preprocessor macros and includes arc-c.def as its macro table. Unlike the similarly named arc-c.def data file, this is executable hook code that calls cpplib; it is not part of the main backend arc.* group.
